A.name: CartPole independent replication and pause/context localization
A.notes: Full 2^3 for fork/pause x clean/damaged; pause clean zero-Adam 2x2; reset-world pause actor corners. Natural D equals damaged-context DDD by full state assertion.

B.name: Asterix pause-reference extension on independent seeds
B.notes: Full pause clean-context factorial; damaged-context four actor corners; natural clean continuation for historical pause. No new competence/onset tuning.

C.name: Actuator-noise independent impairment-family replication
C.notes: Full clean-context factorial; natural-D context actor corners; common fresh-Adam 2x2. Replacement probability .5, uniform over all actions.

E.name: Controlled replay-label exposure and washout state crossing
E.notes: Common damaged learner; real clean-fork C transitions with original versus sign-corrupted old-window reward labels. Buffer, states/actions/ages, env/obs/RNG/counter are otherwise identical. Collect 25 updates with frozen C behavior and identical replay schedule; assert all non-learner states identical after overwrite. Then 2x2 parameter x RAdam crossing and secondary common-zero-moment controls.
E.transition_source: real unrestricted clean-fork C buffer at removal, identical in both arms except selected reward labels
E.amendment: Clarified before any E data: clean-source labels ensure a reward-bearing exposure; original D-era labels can be mostly zero after avoidance learning. No E result or outcome inspected; sample, endpoint and primary corrupted-minus-unmodified contrast unchanged.

D.name: Frozen prospective diagnostic comparison
D.metric: held-out squared-error reduction versus acute_gap; primary practical threshold 10%
D.notes: All coefficients frozen on original 32 before any new cohort run. Raw one-predictor OLS and acute+KL OLS, intercepts included, no hyperparameter tuning. No fitting on held-out data; rank correlations secondary.

primary_inference.correction: Holm across these five phase-13 primary claim p-values; unrun/incomplete studies receive p=1. This does not retrospectively control the entire legacy paper.
primary_inference.A_B: Intersection-union max one-sided paired-t p for: native delay-adjusted harm, standardized-pause total harm, actor main effect <0, Shapley(actor)-Shapley(critic)<0, Shapley(actor)-Shapley(Adam)<0. All AUCs exclude removal checkpoint. Report 95% paired t-CIs; CI/rank shares descriptive when total uncertain.
primary_inference.C: IUT max one-sided paired-t p for same-update harm, actor main effect <0 and actor Shapley below critic and Adam. No persistent-damage claim from this study without a separate pause-reference intervention.
primary_inference.E: One-sided paired-t test of post-washout bad-label minus repaired-label matched-background continuation; claim practically substantial delayed harm only if point estimate <= -1 and globally adjusted p<.05. TOST +/-1 secondary; parameter/optimizer crossing and interactions secondary.
primary_inference.D: One-sided paired-t of per-seed loss(acute_gap)-loss(acute_gap_plus_KL)>0; usefulness requires at least 10% point reduction AND globally adjusted p<.05. Compare all frozen baselines regardless of outcome. No validated failure-probability or causal claim.

secondary_rules.contexts: Report all planned natural/standardized differences, actor swaps in both backgrounds, zero-Adam and reset-context checks. No choosing a context after data; no unique natural-damage decomposition claim.
secondary_rules.native_pause: Historical unbroken clean C at onset+k, from the clean trace; natural damaged continuation is exact damaged-context DDD. The standardized state-level pause is not asserted identical to historical pause.
secondary_rules.equivalence: Context effect TOST margin +/-5% of native clean mean recovery score (prespecified scale rule); also report paired CI. No neutrality claim merely because a difference test is nonsignificant.
secondary_rules.prediction: Prospective cohort, not new-task validation. Primary losses are paired by held-out seed. All other model/rank comparisons and exclusion checks reported as secondary; no refitting after outliers.
secondary_rules.partial: No formal primary analysis until planned cohort complete; incomplete cells/seeds are retained and descriptive only. Never expand seeds or change contrasts after a look.

progress_logging: Only status/elapsed time, no outcomes until full planned cohort; all primary claims and nulls retained.

prospective_completion_exception.conditions: Only if D whole-study gate already passed and the queue 22:45 cutoff interrupts an already begun fixed cohort. Complete only remaining originally specified seed group(s), no fitting/primary look before n16, no seed extension. Finalization still ends by23:40.
